signature.name: VTask.fromOpposite
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {A : Type u_3} -> {B : Type u_4} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [Semiring A] -> [Semiring B] -> [Algebra R A] -> [Algebra R B] -> (f : A →ₐ[R] B) -> (hf : ∀ (x y : A), Commute (f x) (f y)) -> Aᵐᵒᵖ →ₐ[R] B

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: This definition is a total construction; every well-typed pair (f, hf) produces a valid algebra homomorphism with no junk-value conventions needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {A : Type*} {B : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (hf : ∀ x y : A, Commute (f x) (f y)) (a b : A), VTask.fromOpposite f hf (MulOpposite.op a * MulOpposite.op b) = f b * f a
